verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) and its own Neo agent writing, previewing and deploying Pulumi code. `pulumi preview` shows proposed stack changes without applying them, and it can run headlessly via the Automation API or the CLI with scriptable exit codes. That covers the author → plan → review-diff loop, with the user approving before deploy. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented approval/gating step between preview and apply for agent-authored changes, detail on the diff output format presented to the user, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-driven preview workflow.
